scenicChapters.narrative: Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through. 32 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it.

places-passau-haibach-burgus-enns-graber.story: A 220 km round trip from Salzweg - roughly 3 h 48 in the saddle. The stops in between: Oberranna - Kleinkastell, Hirschleitengraben - Wachtturm, Enns - Gräberstraße and back through Hirschleitengraben - Wachtturm. It climbs into the mountains.
